title: 第五章 立威下第六章 李剑锋的试探
content_zh:
在武能的呵斥下，即便拥有巨土镇分铺管事身份，武牛也不敢再做阻拦。
武能几人很快便是来到后院，而武书坐在亭中，继续安静的品茶，似乎先前武能闹出的动静，完全没传到后院一样。
见武书没有起身欢迎自己，武能没好气的道，“武书弟弟，多年未见，如今归来，怕是已经记不清楚自己在武家的身份了？”
武书依旧坐在那里一动不动，武能摆出一副少族长的姿态，气愤道，“武书，别给你脸不要脸。”
将手中香茗放下，武书用一种不可思议的眼神看向武能道，“只敢窝里横的种，在我武书面前没有脸可说。”
不说武能不敢相信，族中竟然有人敢辱骂自己。
随从们都傻眼了。
跟随在武能身后的一名奴仆围护道，“敢跟少族长这么说话，武书，今日若是不给你个教训，你怕是不知道什么叫武家的规矩。”
一群只知道摇尾乞怜的狗奴仆竟敢对他武书这般说话。
武书也是不想和武能等人多费口舌，便是一副不知所谓的看向众人道，“跪下！”
砰砰砰
一股强大的压迫之力，突然出现在武能及其随从身上，众人皆是不可抗拒的跪在地上。
俯视着众人，武书平静道，“多年没有与家族的人打交道了，你们似乎都忘记了我的脾气。”
而在见到武书冰冷的走向自己时，那名跪地随从惊恐道，“你想干什么？你要是敢动我，少族长是不会放过你的。”
本想着给随从几个巴掌，长个记性。随从却是不甘示弱，将武能搬出来吓唬武书，武书不由动了杀心。
“窝里横，身边还养着你这么条仗势狗，死吧！”
两个大步，武书便是出现在随从面前，一掌拍向他脑袋。
“住手。”
在武书对仆人下杀心时，一名少年便是怒发冲冠般的出现，他似乎不受法阵影响，也是一掌拍向武书。
砰砰

武书的手掌直接拍中仆人的脑袋，那仆人的脑袋就像被拍开的西瓜一样，血水飞溅。而向武书出手的少年，却是被身法诡异的赵焚星一掌挡住。
与少年对了一掌后，二人是各退数步，赵焚星是眉头紧皱的。
武家还真是卧虎藏龙，这突然冒出来的少年，不正是武文？在赵焚星的印象里，武家后辈弟子中，除了武书外，没有谁在修行上，算是有天赋的。可与武文对了一掌后，赵焚星能够清楚感受到，武文不仅锻体方面实力非凡，土力修行上，也是功力深厚的。
“锻体七重，土力雄厚。没想到，你们武家中，还隐藏着这种天才后辈。”
武文原本只是想躲在暗中看看武书，毕竟以前在族里，武书的天赋是要比武文高一点的。只是武文没有想到，如今武书归来，一个照面，大哥武能及其奴仆皆无还手之力。
眼见武书出手，又担心武书会向大哥出手，为了保全大哥一命，武文便是不得不全力出手。
而在赵焚星接下自己这一掌后，武文是心惊的。
什么时候家族里还隐藏着这么一个实力恐怖的少女，竟然拥有能够与自己抗衡的实力。另外，此次交手，多年以来的隐忍，怕是都将前功尽弃了。
在看清来者后，武书冷道，“武文？”
在听到赵焚星对武文的实力肯定后，武书变得更加警觉了。武书很清楚，若非是赵焚星出手，刚刚若是被武文一掌拍在他的身上。即便不会死，武书现在也将会是重伤在地的。
武文不甘示弱道，“武书？”
一时间，双方在气势上剑拔弩张，武书没有选择继续出手，武文也是冷冷的看向武书。后院中突然变得安静起来，对于跪地的众人来说，气氛诡异，压迫感十足。
而在武书看来，小时候武文是一个血性十足，家族荣誉感极强的同辈。多年过去，不知道如今如何了？
“我可不记得，什么时候，连武文你都变成窝里横的主了。”
content_en:
Under Wu Neng's scolding, Wu Niu did not dare to stop him even though he had the status of manager of the Jutu Town branch.
Wu Neng and the others soon came to the backyard, while Wu Shu sat in the pavilion and continued to quietly sip tea. It seemed that the noise Wu Neng had made earlier had not reached the backyard at all.
Seeing that Wu Shu did not stand up to welcome him, Wu Neng said angrily, "Brother Wu Shu, I haven't seen you for many years. Now that you are back, you may not be able to remember your identity in the Wu family?"
Wu Shu still sat there motionless, Wu Neng put on the posture of a young patriarch and said angrily, "Wu Shu, don't let me shame you."
Putting down the tea in his hand, Wu Shu looked at Wu Neng with an incredulous look and said, "Those who only dare to be in trouble have no face to speak in front of me, Wu Shu."
Not to mention Wu Neng, I can't believe that someone in the clan dared to insult him.
The followers were dumbfounded.
A servant following Wu Neng surrounded him and said, "How dare you talk to the young patriarch like this, Wu Shu, if I don't teach you a lesson today, I'm afraid you don't know what the rules of the Wu family are."
A group of dog slaves who only knew how to beg for mercy dared to speak to him like this.
Wu Shu also didn't want to waste words with Wu Neng and others, so he looked at the crowd with a look of confusion and said, "Kneel down!"
bang bang bang
A powerful force of oppression suddenly appeared on Wu Neng and his followers, and everyone knelt on the ground irresistibly.
Looking down at the crowd, Wu Shu said calmly, "I haven't interacted with members of my family for many years. You all seem to have forgotten my temper."
When he saw Wu Shu walking towards him coldly, the kneeling follower said in horror, "What do you want to do? If you dare to touch me, the young patriarch will not let you go."
I thought about giving the follower a few slaps to improve his memory. Not to be outdone, the entourage brought out Wu Neng to scare Wu Shu, who was tempted to kill.
"The nest is so messy, and you have such a domineering dog beside you, so die!"
With two big steps, Wu Shu appeared in front of his entourage and slapped him on the head.
"Stop."
When Wu Shu was murdering his servant, a young man appeared in a rage. He seemed to be unaffected by the magic circle and slapped Wu Shu with his palm.
Bang bang
Wu Shu's palm directly hit the servant's head. The servant's head was like a watermelon being slapped open, with blood and water splattering. But the young man who made a move towards Wu Shu was blocked by the palm of Zhao Fenxing's strange movement.
After exchanging palms with the young man, the two of them took a few steps back, while Zhao Fenxing frowned.
The Wu family is really a crouching tiger, hidden dragon. Isn't this young man who appears suddenly, Wu Wen? In Zhao Fenxing's impression, among the younger disciples of the Wu family, except for martial arts, no one was considered talented in practice. But after exchanging palms with Wu Wen, Zhao Fenxing could clearly feel that Wu Wen was not only extraordinary in physical training, but also had profound skills in earth power cultivation.
"Seventh level of body training, rich in soil and strength. I didn't expect that there is such a talented junior hidden in your martial arts family."
Wu Wen originally just wanted to read Wu Shu in secret. After all, in the clan, Wu Shu's talent was higher than Wu Wen's before. It's just that Wu Wen didn't expect that now that Wu Shu had returned and faced each other, neither his eldest brother Wu Neng nor his servants could fight back.
Seeing Wu Shu take action, he was worried that Wu Shu would take action against his elder brother. In order to save his elder brother's life, Wu Wen had to take action with all his strength.
After Zhao Fenxing received his palm, Wu Wen was shocked.
When had such a terrifying girl hidden in the family actually had the strength to compete with herself? In addition, in this fight, all the years of forbearance may have been wasted.
After seeing the person clearly, Wu Shu said coldly, "Wu Wen?"
After hearing Zhao Fenxing's affirmation of Wu Wen's strength, Wu Shu became more alert. Wu Shu knew very well that if Zhao Fenxing hadn't taken action, Wu Wen would have slapped him with a palm just now. Even if he will not die, Wu Shu is nowHe will also be seriously injured on the ground.
Not to be outdone, Wu Wen said, "Wu Shu?"
For a moment, the two sides were at war with each other in terms of momentum. Wu Shu did not choose to continue taking action, and Wu Wen also looked at Wu Shu coldly. The backyard suddenly became quiet. For the people kneeling on the ground, the atmosphere was strange and oppressive.
In Wu Shu's view, when he was a child, Wu Wen was a peer with a strong sense of family honor and full of blood. Many years have passed, I wonder how it is now?
"I don't remember when, even Wu Wen, you became the boss of the house."
